facebook.content_angle: How to choose the right real estate agent when selling your East Auckland home — what most homeowners overlook during the selection process
facebook.post_text:
Choosing the wrong agent could cost you tens of thousands. 🏡

Most East Auckland homeowners spend weeks preparing their home to sell — but only minutes choosing who actually sells it for them.

That decision matters more than almost anything else.

👉 Not all agents negotiate the same — the gap between a good result and a great one often comes down to strategy under pressure
👉 Local knowledge is non-negotiable — an agent who knows East Auckland's suburbs, buyers, and price movements will position your home far more effectively
👉 Marketing reach determines who sees your home — and who competes for it

The right agent doesn't just list your home. They fight for every dollar. 💪

✔️ Ask how they have performed in your specific suburb recently
✔️ Ask what their marketing strategy looks like beyond just photos
✔️ Ask how they handle multiple offers and negotiate on your behalf

The agent you choose is the single biggest lever you have on your final sale price this autumn.
